# Shell

The commands `mt help` lists under Shell. More in [The mt command line](../index.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`help`](#help) | List the commands, or show how to use one |

## help

List the commands, or show how to use one.

```text
mt help [command]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<command>` | text |  |  | The command to describe; leave it out to list them all |

Doesn't need you to sign in.
